verdict.rationale: Publishing guidance on foreign startup instruments is a fair question for a startup law firm, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only US-centric work: Delaware C-corp formation, 83(b) elections and Section 409A/280G. The firm is described as a national U.S. firm with seven U.S. offices, and nothing in the pack shows publications on UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or any other non-US instrument.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
